relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that EA has the potential to upregulate the expression of the BNDF/TrKB/CREB signaling pathway in the hippocampus of CIPD rats.

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: However, treatment with EA and Dulox led to a notable increase in the levels of Syn (p < .05) and PSD‐95 (p < .01).

relationships.subject: CFA-induced chronic inflammatory pain
relationships.evidence_quote: the CFA group demonstrated a decrease in hippocampal levels of 5‐HT and GABA (p < .01), accompanied by an increase in Glu levels (p < .01)

key_findings: EA alleviates pain and depression-like behaviors in CFA rats and restores hippocampal 5-HT/GABA/Glu balance.
EA restores BDNF, TrkB, p-TrkB, p-CREB and PSD-95/Syn in the hippocampus.
